topic: View and Edit Processed Monthly Salary
summary: This process details how to view the processed salaries for a specific month and make necessary adjustments to individual employee salaries, such as adding advance recovery or changing earning/deduction amounts.
steps: Go to HRM > Salary Summary Month Wise.
Select the "Year" and "Month" for which you want to view salaries (e.g., 2025, November).
Click "Go" (leaving other fields blank will show all employees).
Review the list of employees with their processed salaries, including Employee ID, Name, Department, Designation, Payable Days, Gross Salary, Deduction Amount, and Paid Salary.
To make changes for a specific employee, click the "View" button corresponding to their record.
The employee's complete salary structure will open.
To add "Advance Recovery": Locate the "Advance Recovery" deduction head. Enter the desired amount (e.g., 11,000). The system will automatically recalculate Gross Salary, Deduction, and Paid Salary.
To change other amounts (e.g., Basic, other deductions/earnings), edit the respective fields.
Enter "Remarks" explaining the changes made (e.g., "Advance recovery added").
Click "Save". A pop-up will confirm the save.

To add a new deduction or earning head that is not present: Click "Add" under the respective section (Earning or Deduction). Select the head from the dropdown. Enter the amount. Enter remarks and save.
business_rules: Any changes made to an employee's salary structure must be saved with remarks to reflect in the system.
important_notes: This section allows for month-specific adjustments to salary, overriding the contract for that particular month without changing the underlying contract template.
If a required head is not available in the dropdown, it needs to be created first in HRM Setup > Payroll Master.
